description: Get a YouTube transcript. Use when the user gives a YouTube link or video ID and wants the transcript. Default engine=captions reads existing YouTube captions; engine=stt is opt-in speech-to-text (slower, billed per audio minute — 1 credit/min standard, 10 credits/min with speaker labels). Never switch to engine=stt silently: only pass engine=stt when the user explicitly opts in or asks to transcribe the audio. Returns the transcript, or a job id when the request outlives the synchronous window: if a job comes back, poll transcriptlab_get_job_status, then read the text with transcriptlab_retrieve_transcript. The first delivery of each transcript variant can spend credits; later deliveries of that variant are free. When the source is an attached file, a podcast link, or a direct media link, use transcriptlab_transcribe_file or transcriptlab_transcribe_media_url.

also.description: Additional formats to include in a JSON response.

cleanup.description: Strip filler words and stray timestamps from the transcript text.

diarize.description: Label speakers in the transcript. Requires engine=stt; implies tier=premium.

engine.description: captions (default) reads YouTube caption tracks; stt transcribes the audio (opt-in only, billed per audio minute).

lang.description: Caption language, or optional ISO 639-1 spoken language hint when engine=stt (e.g. 'ar', 'en', 'tr'). Omit to auto-detect (recommended).

metadata.description: Include video metadata when available; defaults to true.

speakers.description: Rename diarization labels for engine=stt, e.g. "Speaker 1=Host,Speaker 2=Guest".

tier.description: Speech model tier for engine=stt; normal bills 1 credit/min, premium bills 10 credits/min and supports speaker labels. Defaults to auto.

translate.description: Translate captions to this language when available.

type.description: Caption track type; defaults to any.

url.description: YouTube video URL or 11-character video ID.

name: transcriptlab_get_transcript
title: Get YouTube transcript
